decisions.baseline_expected_action: Use selective market tests without broadening search after one rejection.
decisions.reason: Interview yields useful role information but no offer; current content fit remains real and no new threshold-crossing option exists.

constraint_check.notes: Current employment continues; future search threshold remains intact.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Move only when a new role preserves core judgment and materially improves the current bundle after marginal learning has slowed.
decisions.reason: The offer lowers salary/opportunity density but reduces housing and family distance while preserving requirement and exception judgment.

constraint_check.notes: Role scope, relocation and bundle checks pass.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Treat external acceptance as closure of the narrowed project, not proof that the original broad ambition was right.
decisions.reason: Final accepted manuscript retains the small mechanism-boundary claim produced by years of negative checks.

constraint_check.notes: Editorial process is closed; career consequences are not inferred.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Keep viable service boundaries while testing whether evaluation pressure distorts research choice.
decisions.reason: Second-year review is satisfactory, but autonomy risk has shifted to preference for short measurable projects.

constraint_check.notes: No exit trigger or competing process exists.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Stay when no alternative clears the growth-versus-bundle threshold, while refusing to call current role permanently optimal.
decisions.reason: A full public-market reassessment finds no threshold-crossing alternative.

constraint_check.notes: Annual market refresh can continue without role exit.

audit_rule: Q4 choices remain normal. Acceptance, rejection and continued staying are all produced by prior thresholds and observed bundles, not dramatic deviation.
